summary: HCW Biologics Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering (PIPE) of units consisting of common stock (or pre-funded warrants) and common warrants, raising ~$4.0 million gross proceeds at $1.405 per unit. The 2,846,975 units include 427,046 shares, 2,419,929 pre-funded warrants (exercise price $0.0001), and warrants to purchase up to 2,846,975 shares at $1.28 for 5.5 years. Net proceeds fund clinical trials, IND-enabling studies, and general purposes. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or going-private transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard at-the-market mechanics.
